technique_name: Write an article for a magazine about how the average person can reduce their environmental impact.
description: As individuals, it can be difficult to know where to start when it comes to preserving the environment. However, small changes can make a big difference in reducing our collective environmental impact. Some simple steps to take include reducing our energy footprint where possible - opting for renewable energy sources, joining an environmentally conscious car-sharing club, using public transport or investing in an electric vehicle.
